name: eng-pm-handbook
summary: Advises bounded PM planning, acceptance coverage, work-package quality, risk decisions, self-check, and handoff.
input_contract: Request and source, target actor and outcome, current baseline, constraints and non-goals, supplied decisions or revisions, and requested planning scope.
output_contract: Advisory bounded plan with assumptions and unknowns, observable acceptance, work packages and dependencies, risk decisions, evidence status, next owner, and stop point.
